Commentary.Commentary: Well, we comeback with the worst possible update! The MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED! We got to witness just the one inning and this was shaping up to be a good game. However, it is rain which has come out on top here. That's it from the coverage of this game. Until next time, goodbye and take care!
The covers are firmly placed and we have started to lose overs now.
...THE CHASE...

Afghanistan won't mind a score of around 150 to chase but there were many areas of concern with the ball in hand. Azmatullah Omarzai looked like he lacked match practise as he went for a lot of runs while the spinners, Rashid Khan, Mohammad Nabi and Noor Ahmad were not upto the mark in the middle phase. Still, there is some rust to be shaken off but now Afghanistan will hope their batters can chase down this target as the wicket looks decent enough to bat. Stay tuned. Update! Looks like the groundsmen are expecting some showers and as a result, the covers are back on for now. Stay tuned.

A decent first half of the game and we feel Afghanistan will be happier of the two sides as they bowled well in the final few overs. Oman had wickets in hand but their batters didn't take too many risks when needed and feels like they have ended 10 runs short here. Kashyap Prajapati and Pratik Athavale started really well but it was Aqib Ilyas who along with Kashyap Prajapati added more than 50 runs to put Oman in a strong position but the batters could have gone for some glory shots with so many wickets in the bag.

TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and elected to bowl!
Good news! The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. The ground staff are doing their work. Let's hope we get a start time soon.
We should have had the toss by now but it is raining and the covers are firmly in place! THE TOSS HAS BEEN DELAYED!

Oman on the other hand have already won a game and would look to win this and carry positive momentum into the ICC T20 World Cup group stages. Kashyap Prajapati along with Naseem Khushi would be looking to get into the run-getters as well ahead of the tournament. With both teams looking to gain some good momentum ahead of the ICC T20 World Cup this game would come as a perfect preparations for both sides.

This game will be a perfect way for Afghanistan to gather some momentum and work as a unit to bring out their A-game in the major ICC T20 event. The Afghans will get a good glance at their players and would look to work in the unit. The side would like to give their batters a chance to get used to the conditions and the bowlers to do the same as well.

HELLO AND WELCOME! The warm-up games keep coming thick and fast as this time it will be Afghanistan taking on Oman in the 7th Warm-up match before the ICC T20 World Cup. This is the first game for the Afghan side to get acclimatized to the conditions they will face during this ICC T20 World Cup. Oman on the other hand have already won their first warm-up match against Papua New Guinea.
